name: Heaven Hoodie — Washed Taupe
description:
Heavyweight washed hoodie with a DTF back print: an arched, melting black outline "HEAVEN" with two small lines, "THE CITY ABOVE - WHERE FAITH MEETS TOMORROW" and "FINAL HEAVEN - SEE YOU THERE", and the mark in a pill badge. A black three-star mark sits at the top middle of the chest, and "Final Heaven" is embroidered in black on both sleeves, just above the cuffs.

Heavyweight 350 g washed cotton with a snow-wash finish, relaxed unisex fit. Made to order, and the wash makes every one slightly different. European sizing: if you are between sizes, go one up.

supplier.name: Suning Sufang Yazhi Clothing Co., Ltd.
